import os,json,time,subprocess,traceback,pathlib,sys
R=pathlib.Path('/workspace');os.chdir(R);D=R/'diagnostics';T=R/'tmp/gtk-rootless';T.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
deadline=json.loads((D/'gtk-repair-start.json').read_text())['deadline_epoch']
report={'deadline_epoch':deadline,'system_installation':False,'method':'Distribution packages extracted into workspace; no passwd lookup','commands':[],'chord_timing_audited':False}
def remaining():
    n=deadline-time.time()
    if n<=0:raise TimeoutError('Original 240-second preflight deadline exhausted')
    return n
def run(cmd,name,env=None):
    remaining();entry={'command':cmd,'log':str(D/(name+'.log'))};report['commands'].append(entry)
    with open(entry['log'],'w') as f:
        try:
            p=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=remaining(),env=env);entry['returncode']=p.returncode
        except Exception:
            entry['exception']=traceback.format_exc();raise
    print(name,pathlib.Path(entry['log']).read_text()[-2500:],flush=True)
    if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError(name+' failed; see '+entry['log'])
try:
    for rel in ['state/lists/partial','cache/archives/partial','root']:(T/rel).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    opts=['-o','Dir::State='+str(T/'state'),'-o','Dir::State::status=/var/lib/dpkg/status','-o','Dir::Cache='+str(T/'cache'),'-o','Debug::NoLocking=true','-o','APT::Sandbox::User=','-o','Acquire::Retries=0','-o','Acquire::http::Timeout=12','-o','Acquire::https::Timeout=12']
    run(['apt-get']+opts+['update'],'gtk-rootless-update')
    run(['apt-get']+opts+['--download-only','--no-install-recommends','-y','install','libgtk-3-0t64'],'gtk-rootless-download')
    packages=[]
    for deb in sorted((T/'cache/archives').glob('*.deb')):
        meta=subprocess.check_output(['dpkg-deb','-f',str(deb),'Package','Version','Architecture'],text=True)
        packages.append({'archive':str(deb),'metadata':meta})
        run(['dpkg-deb','-x',str(deb),str(T/'root')],'gtk-extract-'+deb.name)
    report['packages']=packages
    env=os.environ.copy();libdirs=[str(p) for p in (T/'root').rglob('*') if p.is_dir() and any(p.glob('*.so*'))]
    env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']=':'.join(libdirs+([env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']] if env.get('LD_LIBRARY_PATH') else []))
    report['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']=env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']
    run([sys.executable,'-c',"import ctypes,json;g=ctypes.CDLL('libgtk-3.so.0');print(json.dumps({'loaded':True,'gtk_version':[g.gtk_get_major_version(),g.gtk_get_minor_version(),g.gtk_get_micro_version()]}))"],'gtk-rootless-verification',env)
    report['gtk_verified']=True
    src=(R/'bounded_preflight.py').read_text().replace("D/'preflight-start.json'","D/'gtk-repair-start.json'").replace('180-second','240-second').replace('deadline-180','deadline-240')
    (R/'gtk_export_preflight.py').write_text(src)
    run([sys.executable,str(R/'gtk_export_preflight.py')],'gtk-export-preflight',env)
    report['export_preflight_report']=json.loads((D/'bounded-preflight.json').read_text())
except Exception:
    report['exception']=traceback.format_exc()
finally:
    report['finished_epoch']=time.time();report['elapsed_seconds']=time.time()-(deadline-240)
    (D/'gtk-rootless-preflight.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2));print(json.dumps(report,indent=2)[-12000:])
